name: adn-professional-matcher
description: ADN Professional Matcher: a chat assistant that connects visitors with Amicable Divorce Network professionals.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names widget,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run build:watch -w web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
